title: Post-Doctoral Research Visit F/M Postdoctoral position in Quantum Information Theory
institution: Inria (Centre Inria de Saclay, PHIQUS team)
about: Inria's PHIQUS team at Centre Inria de Saclay in Palaiseau, France, is recruiting for a postdoctoral position in quantum information theory (offer 2026-10243). Applications are due 28 February 2027 through the Inria jobs portal.
